canonical_exact_scope: Three distinct statements concern the existing naturally indexed simple InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k, with finite root support, a parent of every required label at each nonroot and child cap k. (1) Rigidity: if every sufficiently late actual cut has crossing count k(k+1)/2, the eventual adjacency is exactly u→v iff u<v≤u+k. One attaining cut does not give this tail conclusion, and adjacency alone does not establish arbitrary-label universality. (2) Encoding, without minimum-width or periodicity assumptions: eventual_encoding constructs a root-free base, C equal to the actual crossing count, initial tokens and a legal fair C-slot schedule; decoded labelled edges agree exactly for every target beyond the base, including edges from pre-base sources, and every actual tail label is below k. Classical finite bijections are used; no regularity, enumeration or fairness is an extra population premise. (3) Conditional realization: if the constructed full named-slot/replacement-label schedule is eventually periodic with positive period p, every infinite word has a strict actual path beginning within one period of that tail. Finite slots do not imply periodicity. The pre-base graph is not reconstructed by the decoder.

theorem persistent_minimum_tail {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k)
    (start : Nat) (hr : p.rootSupport ≤ start)
    (hc : ∀ n, start ≤ n → crossingCount p n = triangular k) :
    ∀ u, start ≤ u → ∀ v,
      (p.edge u v).isSome = true ↔ u < v ∧ v ≤ u+k

theorem eventual_minimum_rigidity {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k)
    (hc : ∃ start, ∀ n, start ≤ n → crossingCount p n = k*(k+1)/2) :
    ∃ start, ∀ u, start ≤ u → ∀ v,
      (p.edge u v).isSome = true ↔ u < v ∧ v ≤ u+k

theorem actual_eventual_fair_encoding {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k) :
    ∃ base C, ∃ S : PortDynamics.Schedule C (Fin k),
      ∃ init : Fin C → PortDynamics.Token (Fin k),
      p.rootSupport ≤ base ∧ C = Fintype.card (Cut p base) ∧
      Nonempty (PortDynamics.Legal S base init) ∧ PortDynamics.Fair S ∧
      (∀ u v (a : Fin k), base ≤ v →
        (p.edge u v = some a.val ↔ PortDynamics.DecodedEdge S base init u v a)) ∧
      (∀ u v label, base ≤ v → p.edge u v = some label → label < k)

theorem actual_tail_labelled_edge_iff {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k) (base : Nat) (hr : Regular p base) (u v : Nat) (a : Fin k)
    (hv : base ≤ v) :
    p.edge u v = some a.val ↔
      PortDynamics.DecodedEdge (schedule p base hr) base (initial p base hr) u v a

theorem actual_schedule_fair {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k) (base : Nat) (hr : Regular p base) :
    PortDynamics.Fair (schedule p base hr)

theorem actual_encoded_periodic_realization {k : Nat} (p : InfiniteLabeledPopulation k k) (base : Nat) (hr : Regular p base)
    {M period : Nat} (hp : 0 < period)
    (hperiod : PortDynamics.PeriodicAfter (schedule p base hr) M period)
    (s : Nat → Fin k) :
    ∃ path : Nat → Nat, base+M ≤ path 0 ∧ path 0 < base+M+period ∧
      ∀ n, path n < path (n+1) ∧ p.edge (path n) (path (n+1)) = some (s n).val

theorem full_labelled_periodic_schedule_realizes_strict {C : Nat} {A : Type} {S : Schedule C A}
    (base : Nat) (initial : Fin C → Token A) {M p : Nat}
    (hp : 0 < p) (period : PeriodicAfter S M p)
    (coverage : IncomingCoverage S base initial) (s : Nat → A) :
    ∃ path : Nat → Nat, base+M ≤ path 0 ∧ path 0 < base+M+p ∧
      ∀ n, path n < path (n+1) ∧
        DecodedEdge S base initial (path n) (path (n+1)) (s n)
